description: Open-source, API-key-gated x402 exact-payment facilitator for Circle USDC on NEAR and Base, with sponsored gas and durable settlement recovery.
notes: Base mainnet API: https://base.x402.mikedotexe.com. NEAR mainnet API: https://x402.mikedotexe.com. NEAR testnet API: https://test.x402.mikedotexe.com. The NEAR mainnet settlement account is x402-relayer2.mike.near; it is listed here rather than in settler_addresses because this form accepts only EVM and Solana address formats. Source: https://github.com/fastnear/x402-facilitator. Sanitized v0.5.1 rollout evidence: https://github.com/fastnear/x402-facilitator/blob/main/docs/evidence/2026-07-26-v051-reference-deployment.md.
